title: Unexpected Ally
next_chapter_hook: The moment Han Lie realized he had been used as a pawn, his expression must have been more unsightly than swallowing a fly—and Chen Ji had already begun looking forward to seeing him fly into a rage.

text.content: The golden runes of the Tianji Record flowed like water in the darkness, Chen Ji sat cross-legged, his fingertips gently stroking the newly acquired Jade Pendant. Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul quivered slightly on the first page, as if responding to some long-unanswered call. He closed his eyes, sensing the information transmitted by the Tianji Record—three breaths later, another fragment of dust-laden memory flooded into his mind.

Yet this rare tranquility was shattered by a thunderous crash. With a boom, the barrier of the hiding place was forcefully broken, and amid the flying dust, a tall figure steeped in killing intent stormed in. Chen Ji's eyelids twitched, his Jade Pendant vanishing into his sleeve in an instant, and he looked up to see a face that screamed 'I am the greatest under heaven'.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji?! So it was this waste hiding here!

text.content: Han Lie grasped his Xuanwu War Halberd, spiritual energy surging around him, clearly having tracked something to this place. His tiger-like eyes swept across the surroundings, seeing Chen Ji curled in a corner of this wretched place—how would this waste end up here? And with no one behind him, he had clearly lost his quarry.

choice.prompt: Facing the intrusion of Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, Chen Ji decided—

choices.description: Adopt a cowardly, timid demeanor to appear weak and unthreatening, using the most lowly posture to lower Han Lie's vigilance.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie lets his guard down
choices.risk_hint: Any slight misstep in acting will expose him

text.content: Chen Ji immediately curled into a ball, trembling all over like a sieve: 'H-Han Senior Brother, spare my life! I was just passing through! I don't know anything!' His eyes, usually so deep and unfathomable, were now filled with terror, resembling a mouse that had encountered a fierce tiger.

dialogue.content: Hmph, at least you know your place! Han Lie coldly snorted, his war halberd striking the ground: 'Waste is waste—can't even stand steady when you see young master! Tell me, did you see anyone pass through here just now?'

choices.description: Use sharp words to expose Han Lie's embarrassment of losing his quarry, leaving him with no way out.
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may attack in his fury

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile so mild it made one's skin crawl: 'Han Senior Brother chased someone all the way to this desolate wilderness, I suppose you lost them? Tsk tsk, the prestigious Xuanwu Sect's number one genius can't even catch a shadow—how embarrassing that would be if word got out.'

What did you say?! Han Lie's eyes went wide, his war halberd pointing directly at Chen Ji's throat, spiritual energy flickering at the halberd's tip, less than three inches from his throat: 'Believe me or not, I can make this mouth of yours shut forever right now!'

choices.description: Pretend to be frightened, 'kindly' offer some ambiguous clues to lead Han Lie in the wrong direction.
choices.visible_reward: Use Han Lie's hands to eliminate enemies

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shrunk his neck and lowered his voice: "Han-shixiong, please don't be angry. I-I just saw someone heading east, wearing... Inner Sect robes!" His eyes darted about as he spoke, looking guilty as sin.

Inner Sect? Han Lie's eyebrows shot up. The Xuanwu Sect and Tianqing Sect had long been at odds, so an Inner Sect disciple appearing here was indeed suspicious. He stared at Chen Ji for a long moment, then harrumphed: "The废物 actually has some use. Which road to the east? Speak clearly!"

text.content: Chen Ji calculated rapidly in his mind. The Tianji Record's foresight just now had told him that Han Lie wasn't the only one who'd lost track of the target—at least three factions were searching this area. If he could send this brute to stir up trouble, perhaps he could lure the snake out of its den and expose the true mastermind.

dialogue.content: Han-shixiong, I've actually been thinking... Chen Ji pretended to hesitate, as if holding back his words: "The person you're chasing has superb lightness skill. Ordinary methods probably won't catch up."

text.content: Han Lie's brow furrowed: When did this废物 learn to analyze problems? Though he felt disdainful, curiosity was piqued: "Speak directly if you have something to say! Stop being so wishy-washy!"

choices.text: Share intelligence in exchange for a favor
choices.description: Pretend to have accidentally learned some insider information, to exchange for Han Lie's favor.
choices.visible_reward: Establish initial contact with Han Lie
choices.risk_hint: Risk Han Lie extracting more intelligence from me

dialogue.content: I've heard... tonight at midnight, someone will appear at the old altar site. Chen Ji lowered his voice, his gaze flickering: "I overheard this accidentally myself. I don't know exactly who it is. But that person seems to be after the Tianji Record."
Tianji Record?! Han Lie shuddered, a glint of greed flashing in his eyes, then stared at Chen Ji with wariness: "How would a废物 like you know about this? Don't tell me you're trying to deceive me?"

choices.description: Set a clear price, demanding Han Lie pay a price before providing intelligence.
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie might not go for this approach

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly switched to a calculating expression, rubbing his fingers together: "Han-shixiong, you know how thin my resources are... This information was obtained at the risk of my life. Don't you think—"
You废物 dare to bargain with this young master? Han Lie laughed furiously, slapping his palm against the stone wall, sending debris flying: "Believe me or not, I'll dismantle your贱骨头 and sell you off!"

text.content: Just as the atmosphere grew tense, distant rumbling sounds echoed, followed by lingering Spiritual Energy fluctuations. Han Lie's expression shifted, pricking up his ears—directly toward the location where his tracked target had vanished.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji blinked, looking innocent: "Oh my, Han-shixiong, it sounds like a fight's broken out over there. Aren't you going to take a look? What if... your target gets snatched by someone else?"

text.content: Han Lie's expression flickered between dark and light. He stared at Chen Ji for a long moment, then suddenly grabbed Chen Ji's collar and hoisted him up: "You'd better not be lying to me! If I discover you're playing any tricks—" His voice dropped to a thunderous low: "I'll show you what it means to live worse than death."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, choked and struggling, forced out an ingratiating smile: "H-Han-shixiong, please rest assured... How would I dare deceive you... cough, could you loosen your grip first? I can barely breathe..."

choice.prompt: After Han Lie released him, Chen Ji made a decision—

choices.description: Proactively volunteer to follow Han Lie to "claim credit", but actually to observe the situation and fish in troubled waters.
choices.risk_hint: Might be caught in the fighting

dialogue.content: "Brother Han, perhaps... I could lead the way?" Chen Ji straightened his collar, his face full of eagerness: "I'm quite familiar with this area, perhaps I could be of help!"
"Hmph, lead the way?" Han Lie sneered, yet didn't refuse: "Fine, you walk in front. If there are ambushes, I'll kill you first!"

choices.text: Stay put and wait for news
choices.description: Let Han Lie explore the path alone, while staying here to bide his time.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance to observe up close
choices.visible_reward: Stay safe and reap the benefits

dialogue.content: "This one won't go and cause trouble..." Chen Ji put on a weak demeanor: "My cultivation is shallow, going would only slow Brother Han down. Why don't I keep watch for you here?"
"Waste of a person!" Han Lie snorted coldly, turning to leave, but then paused: "If I return and find you've run... Hmph." He left a threatening glance and vanished into the night like a流光.

choices.description: Exploit Han Lie's impatient nature, deliberately point him down the wrong path, letting him clash with other forces.
choices.visible_reward: Use a borrowed blade to eliminate potential threats

dialogue.content: "Brother Han, there's a small path that can bypass this area!" Chen Ji pointed in the opposite direction, a hint of cunning flickering in his eyes: "I just saw someone flee down that path!"
Han Lie glanced at him with suspicion, yet chose to trust—at least that's what he told himself. Moments later, angry roars and intense fighting sounds echoed from the distance.

text.content: After Han Lie left, Chen Ji slowly straightened his back, a meaningful smile curling at his lips. He retrieved the Tianji Record from his chest, runes dancing between his fingertips—the scene just now was merely one "possibility" he had witnessed through foresight. What truly intrigued him was, among the chaos in the distance, how many had actually come for him.

dialogue.content: Mr. Mo's voice rang in his mind, tinged with helplessness: "You rascal, daring to toy with a Xuanwu Sect genius... Though I must admit, that move was indeed brilliant."

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, about to respond, when he suddenly sensed a familiar spiritual energy approaching. His expression shifted subtly—it was Su Qingyao's aura. Why would the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow appear in such a remote place? Could she

dialogue.content: Chen Ji immediately suppressed his aura and found a corner to hide. He cursed internally: Han Lie was easy to fool, but Su Qingyao was different. This senior sister's intuition was terrifyingly sharp—one careless move and he would be exposed.

text.content: The footsteps drew closer. Chen Ji held his breath and through a crack caught sight of Su Qingyao's cool, aloof figure standing as sharp as a sword under the moonlight. Her gaze swept across the ravaged hiding spot, her brow faintly furrowed, as if searching for traces. Suddenly, her eyes fixed in the direction where Chen Ji was concealed.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, I know you're there. Su Qingyao's voice was cool and clear as a spring, yet carried an indisputable certainty: "Come out. At my cultivation level, you can't hide from me."

text.content: Chen Ji cursed inwardly. He knew Su Qingyao wasn't bluffing—if she said it, she meant it. He composed his expression and stepped out from the corner, wearing his usual humble smile: "Senior Su, what brings you here? Staying up late for patrol, you must be tired..."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao studied him up and down, a complex gleam flickering in her eyes: "Han Lie just left from here." She paused: "What did you two... talk about?"

text.content: Under the moonlight, Su Qingyao's figure stood as straight as a sword. Beneath her seemingly calm gaze lay three parts wariness, three parts doubt, and four parts... inexplicable emotions. Chen Ji苦笑 in his heart—this senior sister's intuition grew keener by the day; it wouldn't be long before his "waste" persona completely crumbled before her.

Still... the fact that an idiot like Han Lie was willing to talk to a "waste" was itself the greatest flaw in the facade. Su Qingyao recalled the expression on Han Lie's face as he departed—it wasn't the satisfaction of crushing a weaker opponent, but rather... the confusion of someone being led by the nose without realizing it.

dialogue.content: To answer Senior Su's question, Senior Han chased someone here and found only me... Chen Ji rubbed his hands together, looking nervous: "He asked me a few questions, then left. Really, nothing happened!"

Nothing happened? Su Qingyao coldly laughed, walking closer step by step, each step carrying invisible pressure: "Han Lie may be an idiot, but he's not stupid enough to chat idly with a waste. What exactly did you say to him?"

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, a flash of panic crossing his face—of course, even he couldn't tell how much of that panic was genuine and how much was acted. Su Qingyao's intuition was too accurate; he had to be exceptionally careful.

The sounds of battle in the distance gradually subsided, and flames rose into the sky—clearly someone had unleashed a powerful technique. Su Qingyao glanced sideways, her brow creasing—the direction was precisely where Han Lie had left. Meanwhile, Chen Ji silently calculated in his heart: a three-way free-for-all, and now at least two factions had revealed themselves.
Su Qingyao turned her gaze back to Chen Ji, then suddenly asked what seemed like an unrelated question: "Chen Ji, don't you feel like... you've changed a lot?"

The words came unexpectedly, and Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat. Yet his face still wore that weak, cowardly smile: "Senior Sister jokes, I've always been like this..." He lowered his eyes, concealing the sharp glint that flashed across his gaze.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao fell silent for a moment, then suddenly sighed, her attitude softening somewhat: "Never mind. Whatever you have going on... if you need help, you can come to me." With that, she turned and left, her figure vanishing into the night in short order.

text.content: Chen Ji watched her departing silhouette, a playful curve forming at the corner of his lips. Su Qingyao's favor had risen another notch. He withdrew his gaze and reassessed the flames in the distance—this night was destined not to be peaceful. Han Lie's farce was likely only just beginning.

dialogue.content: If that idiot Han Lie realizes he was used as a gun, I wonder how furious he'll get... Chen Ji murmured to himself, a rare hint of ease flickering in his eyes: "But his anger should prove useful, shouldn't it?"

text.content: The night breeze brushed past, carrying distant shouts of combat and residual Spiritual Energy fluctuations. Chen Ji slipped back into the shadows and began calculating his next move in his heart. Han Lie had entered the game, Su Qingyao's suspicions were temporarily suppressed, and those forces lurking in the dark would soon show their hands. This night was only just beginning.

And on the distant battlefield, Han Lie was raging at a group of black-clad figures. He had clearly gone there for his target—how did he end up fighting these inexplicable people? That waste must have tricked him! When he got back, he was going to tear that smiling face of Chen Ji's to shreds!
